items.title: Solo Leveling
items.reason: A progression-first dark supernatural action series whose complete released two-season run turns Sung Jin-woo from the weakest hunter into an overwhelmingly powerful necromancer through an explicit game-like System of levels, stats, quests, skills and class advancement. Its Gates and dungeons provide recurring monster threats, escalating combat tiers and worldbuilding, while the System itself supplies sustained rule discovery, measurable training/growth, broadening abilities, high-intensity action, brutality and gore, and an ongoing mystery around the source of Jin-woo's unique power.
